title: Part dialog confirmation names the part as typed in the form
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DTITLE-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL DTITLE A), is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DTITLE-02), with description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL DTITLE B), is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A} and replace the Description with " ZZAUTOTEST PL DTITLE NEW " (three spaces before and after).
  2. Do not save yet. Pick "Inactive" and click Save.
  3. Read the title and the first line.
  4. Click "Cancel", then Cancel in the part dialog.
  5. On the Inactive tab open {Part-B}, pick "Active", click Save and read the title and first line; click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Titled "Deactivate part?"; the first line is "{Part-A} ZZAUTOTEST PL DTITLE NEW": the number, then the description as typed in the form without the spaces, not the saved {Description-A}.
  • Step 4: Nothing is saved: {Part-A} keeps {Description-A} and stays active.
  • Step 5: Titled "Activate part?"; the first line is "{Part-B} {Description-B}".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R3, S10-R4, S10-N1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3 (Save asks first) and 3.7 (Bringing it back), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”
